gt_provenance.details: CFT consumes three real fit image pairs but no annotation-derived metric. BCDL and CMD checks use synthetic logits/maps or fake teachers, not detector ground-truth evaluation.

score_normalization.details: No AP, benchmark score or comparison normalization is computed. BCDL scope is per-anchor classification loss with removed MMCV decorators; full reduction is explicitly untested. Detection counts and one-shot CPU timings are execution outputs, not accuracy or throughput claims.

result_existence.details: CFT attempt2 receipt and three inference records exist and agree on stems, output shapes and NMS row counts 2/1/2; raw NPZ files exist but were not unpacked. BCDL receipt reports 6 of 6 checks PASS. CMD receipt return codes are zero and original pytest log states 22 passed in 1.68s; help output is present. CFT attempt1 failure is preserved.

dead_code.details: CFT completion is emitted after actual attempt_load, compatibility call, three model calls and NMS; BCDL receipt is generated from executed check functions; CMD records actual CLI and pytest commands. No function definition or source-copy status alone was accepted as execution.

scope.details: CFT is adapted dual-modal author-checkpoint execution only. Historical training forward equivalence remains unproved. BCDL is a classification operator only. CMD teacher remains TO_BIND. No full training, new AP, RGB-only fusion comparison, multi-seed effect or full-paper acceptance follows.

eval_type.details: CFT: real-input mechanical execution without reference scoring, outside scientific GT evaluation. BCDL and CMD: synthetic_proxy numerical/interface checks only; the passing count is not a performance proxy.

source_archive_placement.details: cft_forward90/AUTHOR_ARCHIVE_RECEIPT.json describes M2D-LIF_master_author.zip from Zhao-Tian-yi/M2D-LIF. Excluded as CFT provenance. Original preserved; correct CFT source and weight receipts remain available.
